decisions.reason: The articulated dumper builds directly on the firm's core vehicle engineering and service knowledge, so the firm can interpret its results and keep adapting it, even though related compact construction lines were recently pruned.

The mine rescue vehicle is distant from the core offer and shows no reported results yet, but the firm's underground vehicle experience, its own R&D and the long sales cycles of this niche justify keeping it for now.
The material lift line is close to the established offer, has a long track record as the most popular rental lift and has just won a large order, so it fits the firm's existing knowledge and market.

Although distant from the core offer, the mining loader has logged 1,000 operating hours in seven months, which gives clear field feedback that the firm's underground experience and R&D can absorb to improve the machine.
